config: SPEC=dflash2 CTX=fast MAX_SEQS=1 DFLASH_TOKENS=7 GPU_UTIL=0.90 KV_MEM= (empty: GPU_UTIL-sized pool), max_model_len=65536, kv bf16, FLASH_ATTN
kv_pool: GPU_UTIL-sized: 33.63 GiB available for KV (vs 5.2 GiB pinned in v6)

decode.protocol: greedy, streaming, single request, 88-token prompt, 256 max tokens, ignore_eos, 1 warmup + 3 samples

prefill.protocol: 8192-token prompt, 1 output token, non-streaming, 1 warmup + 2 samples

note: decode slightly below v6 (43.3 vs 47.5 tok/s) - the empty KV_MEM= also disabled the fast-path pin; single-stream decode is bandwidth-bound so pool size does not lift throughput. Prefill is where the fix matters: full 64K context usable.
